designationHistory.indexText: Established on May 1, 2001, when the U.S. Navy transferred about 3,100 acres on western Vieques to the Interior Department under an act of Congress.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Vieques National Wildlife Refuge, About Us
Federal Register, July 9, 2001 (01-17130): Establishment of the Vieques National Wildlife Refuge; under section 1508 of Public Law 106-398 the Navy transferred about 3,100 acres to Interior
FWS story, May 2, 2001: "On May 1, the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service welcomes its newest addition ... the Vieques National Wildlife Refuge"

review.note: Draft sentence (1969, a 45-acre island off St. Thomas) describes Buck Island NWR. Vieques NWR dates to May 1, 2001. Act signed by Clinton (2000); transfer under Bush, so no signer set.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Thomas, was established in 1969 for its "particular value in carrying out the national migratory bird management program." The refuge consists of the entire 45-acre island.
